about: draw-gui's application mutants (wf10 corpus wave GP3a): edits of the example, each with the law or the test that kills it. A killer examples/draw-gui/PKG:law L is `ergo test examples/draw-gui/PKG --law L`; cmd/ergo:TestDrawGuiAgreesWithControl is the seeded agreement property against the plain reference model and the hand Go control, which kills the mutants no law sees.

mutants.name: draw-simplify-drops-too-far
mutants.rule: A dropped point is within Epsilon of the chord that replaces it.

mutants.name: draw-simplify-loses-the-last-point
mutants.rule: A simplified stroke ends where the stroke did.

mutants.name: draw-grid-misses-the-last-column
mutants.rule: The grid holds a shape in every cell its grown box reaches, so a hit finds it at its right edge.

mutants.name: draw-rect-exports-its-height-as-width
mutants.rule: A picture's text reads back as the same picture.

mutants.name: draw-escape-drags-further
mutants.to: let back = Point{X: g.Moved.X, Y: g.Moved.Y}
mutants.rule: An escaped drag leaves every shape where it was.

mutants.name: draw-ellipse-past-the-edge
mutants.rule: Every shape stays inside the world.

mutants.name: draw-move-writes-down
mutants.rule: A command's line reads back as the command.

mutants.name: draw-shelf-saves-another-text
mutants.rule: A saved text is the text that loads.

mutants.name: draw-move-keeps-the-old-cells
mutants.from: Grid:   Index(Unindex(out.Grid, id, p.Value.Shape), id, moved),
mutants.rule: A moved shape is found where it now is.

mutants.name: draw-older-shape-on-top
mutants.rule: Of two shapes on one layer, the later is on top.

mutants.name: draw-rect-moves-across-only
mutants.to: Rect{..r, At: add(r.At, Point{X: d.X, Y: 0})}
mutants.rule: A dragged rectangle moves with the pointer.

mutants.name: draw-band-selects-what-it-touches
mutants.rule: A band selects the shapes wholly inside it.

mutants.name: draw-frame-paints-off-screen
mutants.rule: A frame's paint list holds only what the screen shows.

mutants.name: draw-ellipse-axes-swapped
mutants.rule: An ellipse is hit inside its own radii.

mutants.name: draw-room-measures-from-the-left
mutants.rule: A drag stops where the selection's right edge meets the world's.

mutants.name: draw-svg-takes-a-repeated-id
mutants.rule: A picture's text names each shape once.

mutants.name: draw-zoom-scales-the-wrong-way
mutants.rule: A press lands on the world point the frame shows under it.

mutants.name: draw-view-move-is-a-press
mutants.rule: A pointer moving on the picture drags; it does not press.

mutants.name: draw-view-escape-key-ignored
mutants.rule: The Escape key escapes the tool's gesture.

mutants.name: draw-view-drops-the-first-paint-line
mutants.rule: The window shows a line for every shape on the screen.

mutants.name: draw-view-lacks-a-zoom-button
mutants.rule: The toolbar has a button for each zoom it offers.

mutants.name: draw-scene-pans-the-other-axis
mutants.rule: A pan line presses the button of its own move.

mutants.name: draw-paint-ignores-the-selection
mutants.rule: A selected shape is painted in the selection's colour.

mutants.name: draw-paint-draws-off-screen-shapes
mutants.rule: The paint list holds only the shapes the screen shows.

mutants.name: draw-paint-layers-one-ink
mutants.rule: A higher layer is painted darker.

mutants.name: draw-paint-oval-arms-truncated
mutants.rule: An ellipse's control arms are rounded to the nearest pixel.

mutants.name: draw-paint-hides-the-pending-shape
mutants.rule: A shape being drawn is painted over the picture.
